message: Original PDF 25 speaks of the homology class of v in V_k without restating the cycle condition; preserved verbatim in meaning without adding an assumption.
The printed Maxwell sequence is 1,1,2,4,4,5,5,6,7,7,10,10,13,13,..., whereas the Exact row in Table 1.4 is 1,1,2,4,4,5,5,8,9,9,10,10. Both are preserved exactly; no mathematical correction.
The annular domain is printed without extra grouping around the Cartesian product after set difference. Preserve the displayed delimiters rather than silently adding parentheses.
Original English has the grammatical form 'there is also be'. Chinese preserves the stated existence claim without treating the English typo as additional mathematics.
Three accepted sample symbols use mathcal Z/B, but original PDF 25-26 embeds EUFM10 Fraktur Z/B. Accepted text must not be corrected without explicit user authorization.

details.authorization_needed: Correct only the three logical Z/B expressions from mathcal to mathfrak in the accepted source/translation/registry and regenerate verified output; do not change H or other content.
details.resolution: User rejected Fraktur and approved retaining the existing non-Fraktur Z/B. No accepted source or translation content was edited.

message: Source denotes the subcomplex itself by (S_k, partial_k restricted to S_k). Retain its indexing exactly rather than silently replacing it by a graded-space pair.
The source describes incidence-matrix columns and rows as corresponding to k-chains and (k-1)-chains, not explicitly basis simplices. Preserve this wording without silently narrowing it.

The original summary prints 'cocyles'. The reconstructed English retains this spelling; Chinese translates the intended cocycle term already defined in the chapter, without adding mathematical content.
The source prints 'restriction to T(D) of the X norm'. Preserve T(D) rather than silently changing it to D(T).

Lemma 3.10 is stated for normed linear spaces without an explicit completeness or open-mapping hypothesis. Preserve the source's stated assumptions; do not add Banach-space assumptions to the translation.
The source uses R^3 in the classical normal trace discussion and Theorem 3.12 after beginning the section with a domain in R^n. Preserve each printed dimension, not silently normalize n and 3.
The source uses gamma_tau w in the restriction paragraph but v in the following smoothness sentence. Preserve these source letters exactly.
Box 3.1 floats above the concluding main text on the original page. In the translation it follows the completed section; all summary and main-text content is retained.
Original footnote prints 'occured'. Reconstructed English retains the spelling; Chinese preserves its meaning without inventing content.
The source says homology spaces in the Fredholm criterion discussion even though this section concerns cohomology; preserve the source wording without silently changing it.
The text describes the affine cosets as closed while the section initially allows nonclosed complexes. Preserve the printed statement; no added closedness hypothesis.
The source describes a closed spherical shell but prints strict inequalities a<r<b. Retain both the wording and the inequalities, not silently change either.

Equation 4.18 prints minus signs on the d sigma, du, p and q terms, while Equation 4.19 prints F(tau,v,q)=<f,v> and Equation 4.20 uses B(x,y)=F(y). Preserve all displayed signs and equations as printed; do not silently harmonize them with the earlier mixed formulation 4.16.

The source explicitly calls the mean inequality 'algebraic-geometric', not 'arithmetic-geometric'. Reconstructed English retains it and Chinese translates the literal wording, without a silent terminology repair.
The div-curl application explicitly prints f=grad F after div u=F, although the preceding B problem prints -grad div u=f. Preserve the positive gradient as printed; do not repair the sign.
The source prints ring B^k=B^{3-k}, without a star, and says similarly for Z and harmonic H. Preserve the printed relation, not an inferred dual-boundary relation.

Box 4.1 explicitly prints W^k=B^k orthogonal-sum harmonic H^k orthogonal-sum Z^k, with Z^k as the final summand. Preserve this source expression even though it differs from the earlier Hodge decomposition.
The introduction prints occuring; retain the original English spelling and translate its meaning without new content.
The source prints 'the any nonzero harmonic forms'. Preserve the reconstructed English literally; Chinese conveys the statement without added assumptions.
The W-to-V boundedness display prints c||v||^2+||dv||^2=c||v||_V^2, without c multiplying the derivative term. Preserve the printed factors.
The source names the harmonic space H_h^k while the surrounding paragraph uses index j. Retain the displayed index k, not silently normalize it.
The text calls these homology spaces, not cohomology spaces, after Theorem 5.1. Preserve the wording, as in the source.
Theorem 5.3 and the final proof line use ||dv||_V while the first use of continuous Poincare in the proof uses ||dv||. Keep all subscripts exactly as printed.
Equation 5.16 has a final unmatched right parenthesis after the V norm. The 400-dpi source crop confirms it; retain it without inventing an opening parenthesis.
Equation 5.21 ends in an extra square closing bracket before the final parenthesis. Confirmed in a 400-dpi source crop, retained without silent mathematical correction.
The source spells the personal name Grassman with one final n. Preserve that exact printed form, do not normalize it to Grassmann.
The alternating-form identity prints 1<=i<j<=n although its argument list ends at v_k. Preserve n as printed.
The determinant in the inner-product definition has index range i,j=1 to n although the forms are k-forms. Preserve n as printed.

The source writes the star on the first factor of the unparenthesized wedge expression and uses (-) without an explicit 1 in its sign powers. Preserve the printed expression, not a silently parenthesized or normalized replacement.
The pullback paragraph introduces phi:M->N but says a differential k-form on Omega. Retain Omega in that source sentence and M in the following formula.
After the k=0 formula df, the source says the exterior derivative on a 1-form is the gradient. Retain its printed degree 1, not silently change it to 0.
The chart-definition paragraph prints d omega in Lambda^k(M), not Lambda^{k+1}(M). Retain k as printed.
The integration construction starts with k tangent vectors but the approximation display ends in v_n^(i). Retain n in that display.
The set called a half ball is explicitly printed with |x|=1, not |x|<=1. Preserve the equality and the source description.

The prose calls source object 3.11 Lemma, although its actual environment is Proposition. Preserve the English prefix Lemma in this sentence while linking to the true semantic target prop:trace-functional-representation.

The trace-extension derivation uses (-)^k, unlike (-)^{k+1} in the preceding integration-by-parts identity. Equation 6.17 additionally reverses the order of the two trace factors. Preserve every printed sign, exponent and factor order.
The source says u and du belong to the domain d*, without D(d*). Retain d* rather than inserting a repaired operator-domain expression.
Box 6.1 says a differential n-form satisfies the displayed Stokes formula integrating d omega. Retain its printed degree n and do not add a new hypothesis.

Source page is a blank production leaf containing only printer calibration/registration marks and an InDesign timestamp. No mathematical prose is omitted; the original page remains in the immutable PDF.
The introduction prints the adjoint pair (delta, ring H* Lambda^k), whereas Theorem 6.5 has degree k+1 for the adjoint domain. Retain the source index k in this introductory sentence.
The notation paragraph says the spaces will be defined in the next section even though the chapter outline names Section 7.4. Preserve both source statements.
The identity-vector-field sentence prints 'is display'. Reconstructed English retains the source spelling; Chinese translates its meaning.
The inclusion chain ends with P_r^- Lambda^k after P_{r-1} Lambda^{k+1}. Preserve the printed final degree k, rather than silently changing it to k+1.
The mixed complete/trimmed canonical commutation relation prints degree k on both Pi operators. Retain this printed degree, rather than replacing the left k by k-1.
Equation 7.11 prints degree 1 on its final Whitney space, not n. Preserve the printed degree 1.
The DOF paragraph prints 'uniquely determine an element of phi'. Preserve this wording in reconstructed English and its literal meaning in Chinese, without replacing phi by a space.
The constant-degree comparison names the complete P_r Lambda^k sequence, not the trimmed sequence. Preserve the source comparison.
The serendipity DOF display uses u as the mapped argument, omega and mu in the integral, and q in the test-space membership. Preserve all four printed symbols without normalizing their names.
The source lists H(div) then H(curl), followed by P_r^- Lambda^1 then P_r^- Lambda^2 'respectively'. Retain this order without silently reversing either pair.
Box 7.1 starts 'Give an n-dimension ...'. Reconstructed English retains this wording; Chinese translates its meaning.
This is a blank production leaf with registration/color marks and an InDesign timestamp, not omitted mathematical content. Original PDF retained.
The display Lu=[(d+l1)(delta+l2)+(delta+l3)(d+l4)+l5] has no trailing action on u on its right side. Retain the source display without inserting u.
Equation 8.3 prints u_t+(delta d+d delta u)=f, with u only on the second summand inside the parentheses. Preserve the printed placement, rather than moving u outside.
The concluding energy-conservation sentence is printed without explicitly restricting the source f to zero. Retain the original assertion without silently adding a source condition.

The reconstruction sentence prints H=star_{mu=1} B, with an equals sign, not mu^{-1}. Confirmed in the 400-dpi original crop workspace/pages/source-crops/maxwell-weighted-star.png. Preserve this printed subscript.
Equation 8.21 prints inf_{p in S_h} ||p-q||_0, not inf_{q in S_h}. Preserve the printed infimum variable.
The two-dimensional Stokes complex prints R^n, not R^2, in the middle H^1 space. Preserve R^n.
The three-dimensional asym display prints its last component as tau_12-tau_12. Retain both printed 12 subscripts, not an inferred 21.
The proof says no constraint on the symmetry of f, not rho. Retain the source f.
Both off-diagonal Airy tensor entries are printed -partial^2 phi/partial x_2^2, not mixed derivatives. Preserve both displayed entries.

The Airy-stress paragraph explicitly references (8.8), whose numbered source object is the Faraday equation, while the Airy display is unnumbered. Retain the printed reference through its actual numbered label, flag the source mismatch, and do not guess the intended replacement.
The final weak-symmetry complex prints R^{2x2} in the domain above its arrow, while its base matrix space uses R^{nxn}. Preserve both printed dimensions.
Blank production leaf with printer marks; retained in the source PDF, not missing mathematical content.
